info.title: API.SH: Facebook
info.description: The Facebook API from API.SH: public Facebook data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Facebook's logged-out event search, 10 events per page, with Facebook's own filters. The search cards carry only name and picture, so each event is read for its dates, place, cover and counts (details=false skips that). `available_filters` lists the date and category values Facebook offers for the query. Pagination: pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; it is null on the last page. A query without a location (e.g. "concert") returns fewer results; add location_id or put the place in q.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/facebook-events

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: a place ("New York, NY"), a topic or both.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: today, tomorrow, this_week, this_weekend, next_week, a day (YYYY-MM-DD) or a range (YYYY-MM-DD~YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Start of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD), instead of date.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: End of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Event category: art, causes, comedy, crafts, dance, drinks, film, fitness, food, games, gardening, health, home, literature, music, networking, other, party, religion, shopping, sports, theater, wellness (or a Facebook category id).

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: A Facebook city page id (e.g. 108424279189115 for New York); /facebook/v1/event/details returns city_id for any event.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: false skips reading each event (faster; the search cards then carry only name, link and picture).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Value of `next_cursor` from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The posts Facebook shows logged out for a hashtag: its top post and its most recent post (one each, 1-2 posts in all). Logged out, Facebook shows nothing further on a hashtag page and answers its paging query with "Rate limit exceeded", so there is no next page (`next_cursor` is always null). Each post has text, author, time, media, reaction/comment/share counts and `tab` (top or recent).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/facebook-hashtag

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Hashtag, with or without #, or a facebook.com/hashtag/... URL.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: all (default: top and recent post), top or recent.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The server-rendered Marketplace search page: 24 listings. Logged out, Facebook's Marketplace search API answers with empty pages (checked Oct 2026), so there are no further pages; narrow the search with the filters instead. All filters are applied by Facebook. Without q, `category` browses a category with the same filters. get.description:
Every field of a public page's About tab, read from its four sub-tabs in parallel: categories, address with map pin (latitude/longitude), phone, email, websites, social links (Instagram, X…), rating ("98% recommend") and review count, hours status, price range, services, the long description (`about`), privacy policy and impressum, and Page transparency (Page ID, creation date, whether the page is running ads, the confirmed owner). `sections` lists every section and field as Facebook shows them; a sub-tab that could not be read is named in `sections_failed`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/facebook-page-about

parameters.description: Page URL or username (profile.php?id=… links work too).

parameters.name: sections
parameters.description: Comma-separated subset of contact, details, privacy, transparency (default: all four).

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
